Aequinox on bsc is a Balancer V2 fork (vault 0xee1c8dbfbf958484c6a4571f5fb7b99b74a54aa7): its dispatcher has exactly 26 standard Balancer functions, all user-driven (swap/batchSwap/join/exit/flashLoan) or owner-setters - no function pays the caller; swap fees (1% observed) go to the LP. Observed pool is a plain weighted pool (checkpoint() reverts, reward getters revert), so no keeper-style reward exists at pool level either. Protocol is live but bursty and small.
